name: Sultana Caramels
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ½ cup English walnut or hickory nut meat, cut in pieces
ingredients.originalText: ½ cup English walnut or hickory nut meat, cut in pieces

instructions.text: Put butter into a saucepan; when melted, add sugar, milk, and molasses.
Heat to boiling-point, and boil seven minutes.
Add chocolate, and stir until chocolate is melted; then boil seven minutes longer.
Remove from fire, beat until creamy, add nuts, raisins, and vanilla, and pour at once into a buttered tin.
Cool slightly, and mark in squares.
The nut meats and raisins may be omitted.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put butter into a saucepan; when melted, add sugar, milk, and molasses.
2. Heat to boiling-point, and boil seven minutes.
3. Add chocolate, and stir until chocolate is melted; then boil seven minutes longer.
4. Remove from fire, beat until creamy, add nuts, raisins, and vanilla, and pour at once into a buttered tin.
5. Cool slightly, and mark in squares.
6. The nut meats and raisins may be omitted.
